items.description: Anand James of Geojit Investments has recommended two stocks to buy today - Avalon Technologies and Healthcare Global Enterprises.

items.description: Shrikant Chouhan of Kotak Securities has recommended Narayana Hrudayalaya and Mrs Bectors Food Specialities as top picks for today.

items.title: Adani group stocks jump up to 3% on US court relief for Gautam Adani
items.description: Brooklyn-based US District Judge Nicholas Garaufis dismissed conspiracy, securities and wire fraud charges brought against them in a late-night order, marking an end to Adani's US legal troubles.

items.title: ZEEL drops 5% as weak ad revenue drags Q1 profit by 48%; should you buy?
items.description: Analysts at Motilal Oswal Financial Services said ZEEL delivered another subdued quarter. The firm's consolidated profit in Q1 declined by 48.3 per cent to ₹74.3 crore.

items.title: Gland Pharma rallies 12%, hits 4-year high; should you buy, hold or sell?
items.description: Gland Pharma Share: The market price of Gland Pharma hit a high of ₹2,989.2 in intra-day deals on Tuesday. The stock bounced back 90 per cent from its 52-week low of ₹1,575 touched on March 16, 2026.

items.title: Kolte-Patil shares zoom 19% to hit fresh 52-wk high after Q1 turnaround
items.description: Kolte Patil Developers' net profit was ₹146.3 crore for the first quarter of FY27, compared with a loss of ₹17 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
